rules.known_face: Face Value requires a likeness the history-curious have actually seen: a photograph, a famous painting, or a genuinely famous bust (Caracalla yes, Pliny no). Ancients with invented portraits go Lifeline-only. Saints can carry Face Value through canonical iconography (St George + dragon) even without a true likeness.
rules.specific_not_generic: Only a SPECIFIC thing is ever in: a named individual object (Sputnik 1, the Lusitania), never a type/class/make however famous (no OBE, no Victoria Cross, no VW Beetle). Owner ruling 27 Jul 2026.
rules.type_exceptions_why: Concorde: tiny production run, unmistakable, aviation history in one silhouette. Enigma: unmistakable look, one pivotal story, pool has no codebreaking. Exception list is CLOSED at these two unless Daniel reopens it.
rules.tradition_maps: Lifeline points may rest on ancient-historian tradition (Sun Tzu via Sima Qian) but not pure legend (St George, Thomas the Apostle stay off the map).
